author.name: J.D. Nicholls is building in public

summary_md: **J.D. Nicholls is building in public ([@jdnichollsc](https://x.com/jdnichollsc/status/2115364600988455409))** introduces **Seam**: drop two shots (images, clips or 3D models), pick an effect, and LTX-2.5 renders the in-between on ComfyUI, with every take saved as a workflow. The self-reply adds that it is MIT, open-weights only, and ships an MCP plugin so Claude Code can make takes too (jdnichollsc/seam).

referenced_urls.title: Seam — two shots in, one transition out

GitHub - jdnichollsc/seam: Two shots in, one transition out. Open-source AI video transitions (smoke, water bend, whip pan) from a first and last image, rendered on your own GPU with open-weights LTX models via ComfyUI + the Comfy SDK. Web app, CLI and a AI agent plugin.

relevance: Open, local transitions as reproducible workflows that a coding agent can drive over MCP.
